name: Juno Chorus
description: The Juno-60's MN3009 bucket-brigade chorus, from Ultramaster KR-106 (Karl LaRocca, GPL-3): modelled from hardware measurements, with the BBD's filters, its triangle LFO (sine in I+II), compander noise and clock leakage. Mode I, II or both.
